en: A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European city in a river valley, showing dense late‑19th‑century urban buildings and two prominent Gothic‑revival churches with tall spires and crosses. In the foreground stands a large neo‑Gothic church with pointed windows and buttresses, next to tree‑lined streets and a railway or tram line. Beyond it are rows of multi‑storey townhouses and industrial buildings with a tall factory chimney. In the background, steep hillsides are terraced with vineyards and scattered villas, with a fortress‑like structure on the ridge.
